narrative.overview: Museum authority frames matter that can only exist in computation. The interface recedes while scale, topology, light, and camera movement carry the experience.

rules.name: The Contact Rule
rules.body: Gold is rare and appears only as response, classification, or focal spark.

rules.name: The Real Depth Rule
rules.body: Use space, light, and occlusion instead of glass-card simulations.

dos: Give one artifact visual sovereignty per chapter.
donts: Do not introduce generic landing-page patterns.
Do not use built-in easing or high-frequency ornamental motion.
